about_short_description.short_description: Penciled offers AI-powered front desk automation for physical therapy clinics with scheduling and EHR integration.

product.name: Nicole AI Front Office Assistant
product.description: An AI-powered assistant that automates scheduling, reminders, cancellations, and waitlist management for physical therapy clinics, integrating with EHR systems like WebPT and Healthie.

product.name: Automated Plan-of-Care Scheduling
product.description: A system that scans EHRs for prescribed visits and automatically books them into available slots, ensuring patients complete their full treatment plans.

product.name: AI-Driven Waitlist Management
product.description: An AI system that monitors cancellations in real time and automatically contacts waitlisted patients to fill open appointment slots quickly.

product.name: Conversational AI Reminders and Rescheduling
product.description: An AI-powered system that sends two-way SMS and voice reminders to patients, handles cancellations, reschedules appointments, and collects fees automatically.

identifier.value: Standalone AI Scheduler for EHR Downtime

product.name: Standalone AI Scheduler for EHR Downtime
product.description: A backup AI scheduling system that operates independently of EHRs to enable patient self-booking and waitlist management during EHR outages.
